purpose: Test whether non-target pools add residual information to a rolling-calibrated terminal UMAREN market through an offset conditional-logit; direct market replacement is secondary.

prior_art_equivalence.crux_joint_T0_T1_head_to_head: done: 9h snapshot, lambda fit <=2023, eval 2024-25, market LL 3.343 < Harville 3.380
prior_art_equivalence.rule: T0/T1 are reproduction anchors only; novelty is T2 soft-fukusho and calibrated offset residual

known.TANPUK: win/place odds time series plus pool-total votes
known.UMAREN: all unordered-pair odds time series plus pool-total votes

data.vote_rule: pool totals are optional liquidity metadata, never combination-level votes

sealed_caveat: 2024/2025 already opened for T0/T1 head-to-head by crux_joint; sealed only for T2 and offset test

population.target_grid_missingness: settlement_unavailable exclusion reported after base population is fixed

sample_space: all unordered starter pairs C(n,2), positive and normalized within race
primary_loss: race-level categorical logloss of realized unordered top2 pair

null_market.primary: power-law calibrated devig m proportional to (1/odds)^gamma, gamma fit on <=Y-1
null_market.rule: PASS only if calibrated primary null is beaten

t2_rules.claim: unique only under the declared MaxEnt prior, not identified by observed marginals

power.practical: minimum true delta with expected log-growth >=1e-4/race in noise-aware selective-participation simulation, takeout 0.225, entry max(q_est/m_cal)>1/0.775

development.rolling_rule: year Y fitted only with Y-1 and earlier

placebos: matched-race source time shift using TANSHO entropy cells
target-null resample from rolling calibrated UMAREN

M1.comparison: predeclared offset arm minus calibrated terminal UMAREN
M1.PASS_PRACTICAL: CI95 upper<0, practical floor met, 4/5 years, 4/5 seeds if applicable, all LOO CI upper<0, placebo pass
M1.PASS_SIGNAL: same statistical conditions but below practical floor

M2.input: pre non-target pools plus UMAREN pre-to-terminal drift fit <=Y-1
M2.rule: freeze target, fit, loss and floor before M1 results
M2.progression: only PASS_PRACTICAL can propose separate ticket experiment
